text:
lina: quick heads-up 1: we ran an A/B microexperiment for v4-int4 with a behavioral-anchor layer on the long-doc route. overall latency looks fine, but the anchor concordance metric dipped on a few anchor prompts. sharing notes + proposed gate.

omar: can you summarize the A/B numbers? which anchors moved and by how much?

lina: from the 3h AB (10k sessions): global MRR delta -0.3% (ns), anchor-concordance on anchor set A -2.1% (p=0.02), anchor set B +0.4% (ns), hallucination-rate +0.2pp. p95 latency +30ms. cost/tokens -12%. anchors are targeted paraphrase-check prompts + instruction-following examples.

tara: interesting. anchor-concordance is our strongest early-warning signal for behavior regressions. I propose a staged anchor gate: if any anchor set drops >=2% with p<0.05 over a 3h window, pause ramp and start targeted shadowing for that anchor class for 24h. if after 24h anchored-concordance remains down by >=1.5% -> hard rollback. fallback also if hallucination increase >=0.5pp.

ops-bot: note: we already have a generic MRR fallback at 1.5% over 2h. this anchor gate would be stricter for behavior-critical slices.

omar: operationally: do we want the anchor check to be slice-aware? e.g., different thresholds for long-doc anchors vs short-turn anchors? long-doc anchors have higher variance.

lina: yes, propose adaptive thresholds: long-doc anchors threshold=2.0%, short-turn anchors threshold=1.0%. also require 2 consecutive windows of 3h stability before promoting to next traffic tier. ramp schedule: 1% -> 3% -> 10% -> 25% (if stable).

tara: also run a KL-divergence check on top-k token distributions for anchor prompts. if KL>0.12 and anchor-concordance drop >=1% then treat as urgent. this helps catch distributional shifts not visible in MRR.

omar: agree. propose tie-breaker logic: if anchor-concordance drop is local to an anchor but global MRR is stable (<0.3%), do not auto-rollback; instead convert to extended shadow + additional evals (1M tokens) for 48h. only global anchor collapse triggers immediate rollback.

lina: implementation plan (snippet):

```yaml
anchor_gate:
  prompts: ["A", "B", "C"]
  thresholds:
    longdoc: 2.0
    shortturn: 1.0
  window_hours: 3
  stability_windows_required: 2
  kl_threshold: 0.12
  hallucination_pp_threshold: 0.5
  global_mrr_guard: 0.3
  ramp: [1,3,10,25]
  post_detection_action: "shadow_24h_then_promote_or_rollback"
```

ops-bot: scheduled: anchor-monitor job created for thread 1712409999. will start collecting targeted evals and KL profiles. will post 24h summary.

omar: one more we should do 1: add a capacitor on small-traffic anchors: if anchor set traffic <0.5% then increase threshold by 50% to avoid noisy rollbacks. also add a cooldown 90m after rollback and randomize promotion windows +/-15% to avoid regional thundering.

tara: sounds good. I'll update the canary playbook and the promotion service to include the KL check and anchor profiles. Lina, can you schedule a full 48h shadow with trace dump and sample-level diffs for anchors A and C?

lina: scheduled. action items: (1) add anchor-gate yaml to canary config, (2) start 48h shadow for anchors A/C at 3% traffic, (3) collect 1M token anchor traces + KL stats, (4) add dashboard panel for anchor-concordance by anchor set with 1h aggregation. will report back.

omar: thanks. ops-bot: please notify #eng-ml if anchor-concordance < -1.5% in any 3h window.

ops-bot: ack 1: alert rule created. will post results in 24h and 48h. :robot_face:"
